query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_festas,
  SUM(valorTotal)/100 as valor_total_reais,
  SUM(valorPago)/100 as valor_pago_reais,
  SUM(valorTotal - valorPago)/100 as valor_pendente_reais
FROM festas 
WHERE dataFesta <= '2025-11-27';
